title: Monotonicity and Local Extrema of a Cubic
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find intervals of increase/decrease and all local extrema for f(x) = 2x^3 - 9x^2 + 12x - 3.

steps.title: Compute f'(x) and Factor
steps.why: Critical points are x = 1 and x = 2.

steps.title: Construct Sign Chart for f'(x)
steps.mathExpression: x < 1 \implies f' > 0; \quad 1 < x < 2 \implies f' < 0; \quad x > 2 \implies f' > 0

steps.title: Apply First Derivative Test
steps.mathExpression: x = 1: (+ \to -) \implies \text{Local Max } f(1) = 2 - 9 + 12 - 3 = 2; \quad x = 2: (- \to +) \implies \text{Local Min } f(2) = 16 - 36 + 24 - 3 = 1
steps.explanation: Classify extrema based on sign changes.
